And adding to some of the original notes - as some of you know I take a very politically incorrect stance on resale. Thanks to the ridiculous low purchase limits and measures taken by Twickets, many hapless fans stranded overseas were unable to sell their tickets for any price at all. Likely quite a shock to them and a further kick over not making the trip (and I am sure all of us have been there at one time or another) since the tour was so hyped that they likely thought as in England there was limitless demand and they would just sell. And then to get my one $70 each offer only for Twickets to block the sale. I might try the same with another overhyped destination event coming up but to be honest I am kinda burned out on all this.
